parameters.name: PageNumber
parameters.description:
The number of the page to return.

Pages start from page 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The number of entries to return on each page.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 10.

parameters.name: ParentFolderId
parameters.description:
The ID of the parent folder.

If you leave this parameter empty, the information of the first-level subfolders of the Root folder is queried.

parameters.name: QueryKeyword
parameters.description:
The keyword used for the query, such as a folder name.

Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: Tag
parameters.description: The tags. This parameter specifies a filter condition.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun resourcedirectorymaster list-folders-for-parent --parent-folder-id r-b10000 --query-keyword rdFolder --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --tag Value=v1 Key=k1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun resourcedirectorymaster ListFoldersForParent --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key k1 --PageSize 10 --PageNumber 1 --Tag.1.Value v1 --QueryKeyword rdFolder --ParentFolderId 'r-b10000' --method POST --force
